fields.label: Why this can't be a binding rule
fields.description: The last resort, for a transaction Tier-1 filters genuinely can't separate from others on the same account — same direction, same party, same cost centre, distinguishable only by a human knowing what it actually was. Required so the override still means something to someone else in six months.

fields.options:
Manual
Rule Suggested — Confirmed
Rule Suggested — Changed
fields.label: Decision Kind
fields.description: Manual: typed from scratch, exactly today's process. Confirmed: the Classification Queue suggested this line and the accountant agreed. Changed: the Queue suggested a DIFFERENT line (see Suggested Line) and the accountant picked this one instead — this is what feeds rolling_precision back to the rule that got it wrong.

fields.label: Suggested By Rule
fields.description: Which Active rule (if any) produced the suggestion this decision is a response to. Blank for Manual decisions.

fields.label: Originally Suggested Line
fields.description: Only set when Decision Kind is 'Changed' — what the rule suggested, distinct from Line above, which is what the accountant actually chose.

fields.label: Confidence At Decision
fields.description: The rule's rolling_precision at the moment this suggestion was made — a snapshot, not a live link, so this record stays an accurate audit trail even after the rule's own precision later changes.
